<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";
  var PERIOD = 1500;
  var KT = [0,200,400,600,800,1000,1200,1400,1500];
  var tracks = {
    lRot:  [0,0,3,8,9,8,9,8,0],
    lHx:   [0,0,0.5,1.5,2,1.5,2,1.5,0],
    lHy:   [0,-0.5,-1.5,-4,-5,-4,-5,-4,0],
    lEx:   [0,0,0.5,2,2.5,2.5,2.5,2.5,0],
    lEy:   [0,0,-0.5,-1.5,-2,-2,-2,-2,0],
    lSmile:[1,1,1,0,0,0,0,0,1],
    lOpen: [0,0,0,1,1,1,1,1,0],
    lWx:   [0,1.5,0.5,0,0,0,0,0,0],
    lWy:   [0,0.6,0.2,0,0,0,0,0,0],
    lBob:  [0,-1,0,-1.5,-0.5,-1.5,-0.5,-1,0],
    rRot:  [0,1.5,-1,-2,-1,-2,-1,-1.5,0],
    rHx:   [0,-0.5,0,-1,-1.5,-1,-1.5,-1,0],
    rHy:   [0,-1,0.5,-1,0,-1,0.5,-0.5,0],
    rEx:   [0,0,-0.5,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,0],
    rSmile:[0,0,1,1,1,1,1,1,0],
    rOpen: [1,1,0,0,0,0,0,0,1],
    rArm:  [0,-4,0,-4,0,-4,0,-2,0],
    rBobX: [0,0,-0.5,-1,-1.5,-1.5,-1.5,-1,0],
    rBobY: [0,-0.5,-1.5,-0.5,-1.5,-0.5,-1.5,-1,0]
  };
  function sample(name, t){
    var v = tracks[name];
    t = ((t % PERIOD) + PERIOD) % PERIOD;
    var i = 0;
    while (i < KT.length - 2 && t >= KT[i+1]) i++;
    var t0 = KT[i], t1 = KT[i+1];
    var u = (t - t0) / (t1 - t0);
    if (u < 0) u = 0; if (u > 1) u = 1;
    var e = u*u*(3-2*u);
    return v[i] + (v[i+1]-v[i])*e;
  }
  function el(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }
  function setT(id, s){ el(id).setAttribute("transform", s); }
  function setO(id, o){ el(id).setAttribute("opacity", o.toFixed(3)); }
  function render(t){
    t = Number(t) || 0;
    var s = function(n){ return sample(n, t); };
    setT("character-left", "translate(0 " + s("lBob").toFixed(3) + ")");
    setT("head-left", "translate(" + s("lHx").toFixed(3) + " " + s("lHy").toFixed(3) + ") rotate(" + s("lRot").toFixed(3) + " 60 124)");
    setT("eyes-left", "translate(" + s("lEx").toFixed(3) + " " + s("lEy").toFixed(3) + ")");
    setO("mouth-left-smile", s("lSmile"));
    setO("mouth-left-open", s("lOpen"));
    setT("writing-left", "translate(" + s("lWx").toFixed(3) + " " + s("lWy").toFixed(3) + ")");
    setT("character-right", "translate(" + s("rBobX").toFixed(3) + " " + s("rBobY").toFixed(3) + ")");
    setT("head-right", "translate(" + s("rHx").toFixed(3) + " " + s("rHy").toFixed(3) + ") rotate(" + s("rRot").toFixed(3) + " 140 106)");
    setT("eyes-right", "translate(" + s("rEx").toFixed(3) + " 0)");
    setO("mouth-right-smile", s("rSmile"));
    setO("mouth-right-open", s("rOpen"));
    setT("arm-belly-right", "rotate(" + s("rArm").toFixed(3) + " 136 142)");
  }
  window.nwb = { render: render };
  render(0);
})();
</script>
